title: Jeff Linwood: The Future of Code Review and AI | Builders Podcast #2
summary: In this episode of AIMUG Builders, host James Coffey interviews Jeff Linwood, a seasoned software developer with over 25 years of experience. Jeff shares his insights on how large language models (LLMs) are revolutionizing the software development life cycle.
